system.concept: A @UUID[Compendium.stonetop.stonetop-journal.JournalEntry.NS2bhYMi23m0eWao]{Hillfolk} sorcerer who seeks power for its own sake, heedless of rule or taboo.
system.description: Where a spirit-talker uses their power with care and only for their people, the hdour steps over every line — seeking power for power's sake, using it selfishly. @UUID[Compendium.stonetop.stonetop-journal.JournalEntry.NS2bhYMi23m0eWao]{The Hillfolk} fear them, and with reason: even slaying one is perilous, for a dying hdour's curse can damn its killers (see the @UUID[Compendium.stonetop.stonetop-journal.JournalEntry.sgwKSp8PEmkIv21v]{Ghostly Legion}).
